# Elgato Camera Hub triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot starts looking after your webcams (you press Connect, or it connects on start). Webcam control only works on Linux for now.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%backend%` | The method Cuebot uses to talk to the webcams, like V4L2 |

<small>Type id: `elgato.cameraHub.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot stops looking after your webcams (you press Disconnect, or Cuebot closes the link).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | Why it stopped |

<small>Type id: `elgato.cameraHub.disconnected`</small>

## Webcam Anti Flicker Changed

Runs when a webcam's anti-flicker setting changes (it stops lamps from flickering on camera). Cuebot checks about every 2 seconds, so changes from other programs show up with a short delay.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Webcams** | Which webcam to watch, by the name Cuebot shows, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every webcam. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the webcam |
| `%deviceId%` | The webcam's own ID number |
| `%devicePath%` | Where the webcam sits on your computer, like /dev/video0 |
| `%antiFlicker%` | The new setting: Off, 50 Hz, 60 Hz or Auto |
| `%oldAntiFlicker%` | The setting before the change |

<small>Type id: `elgato.cameraHub.webcam.antiFlickerChanged`</small>

## Webcam Live Shutter Speed Changed

Runs when the webcam changes its own shutter speed because auto exposure is on. Cuebot checks about every 2 seconds, so changes from other programs show up with a short delay.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Webcams** | Which webcam to watch, by the name Cuebot shows, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas. Leave empty to react to every webcam. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deviceName%` | The name of the webcam |
| `%deviceId%` | The webcam's own ID number |
| `%devicePath%` | Where the webcam sits on your computer, like /dev/video0 |
| `%shutterSpeed%` | The new shutter speed, like 1/60 |
| `%oldShutterSpeed%` | The shutter speed before the change |
| `%exposure%` | The new exposure time as a plain number (tenths of a millisecond) |
| `%oldExposure%` | The exposure time before the change, same units |

<small>Type id: `elgato.cameraHub.webcam.liveShutterSpeedChanged`</small>
